responseRejectionEvidence.observer: Existing public Client.OnAfterResponse; read-only method, Range, status, Content-Range, Content-Length and Err snapshots; returns nil
responseRejectionEvidence.fixtureErrors: Always rejected including cleanup and error paths
responseRejectionEvidence.clearRejection: Requires actual intended server exchange and matching client response; excludes concrete context, network, timeout and I/O causes and the actual no-response transport failure
responseRejectionEvidence.urlError: Wrapper alone is not rejected; inspect chain and actual response/cause evidence, without matching production error strings
responseRejectionEvidence.concurrentBodies: Correct rejection or successful complete fallback may abort unused concurrent bodies; always reject FixtureError, require the actual target response, and require complete necessary body evidence before a business assertion
responseRejectionEvidence.headZero: Actual zero HEAD may yield successful empty output or clear non-timeout rejection
responseRejectionEvidence.headUnknown: Success requires actual complete full GET/200 and correct entity bytes/hash; otherwise clear non-timeout rejection
responseRejectionEvidence.httpProtocolError: Not blanket-excluded: may be a legitimate metadata rejection after the actual target response prerequisite; missing HTTP response remains a fixture precondition failure
responseRejectionEvidence.genericTransportCause: Reject an observed no-response transport error when it is on the Do error chain, even if an outer URL wrapper has an otherwise plain underlying error

windowsCloseEvidence.openControl: Same os.OpenFile O_RDWR|O_CREATE|O_TRUNC mode0600; open rename must fail
windowsCloseEvidence.closedControl: Explicit Close then rename/remove must succeed
windowsCloseEvidence.requiredReachedStage: Do success and complete entity precede actual destination rename/remove; early Do/temp-removal failure is only a precondition failure

optionalChildAtomicProfiles.failedPolicy: Nonzero, interrupted, watchdog, runtime/race/fixture/timeout or invalid/missing profile is forensic material only, never passing coverage evidence
